conceptZh: 科學家老鼠按下燒杯的按鈕，三滴水點先蹦出來，再有一個盒子彈出一朵浪花，浪花帶著一堆泡泡把「浪」的筆畫沖到位。
object: a bespectacled cartoon lab mouse in a tiny white coat, bubbling glass beakers and a spring-loaded jack-in-the-box full of foamy blue water
morph: three water drops and a good-sized crest of foam burst out of a box and wash the strokes of 浪 into place
creativeAngle: 驚喜彈出：用彈簧盒裡彈出的浪花帶出氵部與「良」，實驗室燒杯跟著冒泡，老鼠被嚇一跳後得意地在旁邊跳舞。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy with a locked frontal camera, bright and warm, no flashing. Setting: a clean solid pale butter-yellow lab bench backdrop with a few bubbling beakers lined up at the bottom edge. The only on-screen text is one bold, saturated ocean-blue Traditional Chinese glyph 浪, built as three water-drop strokes on the left (the water radical) beside the 良 component on the right, centered, uncropped, filling about 70% of frame height with generous margins. The lead is a bespectacled cartoon lab mouse in a tiny white coat with round glasses, an original character, no real people. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): the mouse tiptoes in carrying a clipboard, pats a red spring-loaded jack-in-the-box, and the lid slams open; three round blue water drops shoot out one after another and stack down the left side as the water radical, while the first spoken 浪 lands as the box pops. Moment two (1.8-3.6s): the mouse does a huge double-take, glasses sliding down his nose, then a second beaker next to him fizzes over and the right-hand 良 slides in on a little tide of foam, each stroke clicking into place exactly as the second 浪 is spoken. Moment three (3.6-5.0s): a fat curling crest of soft foam bubbles bursts out of the box, the mouse hops onto a floating bubble and rides it in a loop, and the word 浪花 is spoken the moment the foam flower blooms and a little bubble pops on his nose. From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 浪 is completely still, unobstructed and crisp in blue; the mouse sits on the bench far from the strokes, polishing his glasses with a happy wiggle, a single bubble drifting slowly past. Narration (off-screen only, warm Taiwanese Mandarin, slow, distinct, clear tones, no erhua): the voice says exactly 「浪、浪、浪花」, read as ㄌㄤˋ、ㄌㄤˋ、ㄌㄤˋ ㄏㄨㄚ, first utterance at about 0.6s, second at about 2.7s, the word at about 4.4s, then stop with no repeats and no extra speech. Only soft pops and fizz under the voice, no background music. No subtitles, no vocabulary text, no watermark, no clutter, no real people.
